title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Create a web-based village hall booking system to manage room reservations, track availability, prevent concurrent double-bookings, and issue automated email confirmations.
latestMessage: Create a web-based village hall booking system to manage room reservations, track availability, prevent concurrent double-bookings, and issue automated email confirmations.

steps.title: Database Schema Design for Bookings
steps.instruction: Design and implement a relational database schema using PostgreSQL to manage resources (halls/rooms), users, and reservations with appropriate date/time constraints.
steps.acceptance: The database schema is initialized, constraints prevent overlapping primary keys, and sample records can be successfully inserted into all tables.

steps.title: Calendar Availability API Endpoint
steps.instruction: Develop a backend GET endpoint to query and calculate available hours for a given venue on a specified target date.
steps.acceptance: The endpoint correctly returns a JSON list of available time blocks, accounting for existing reservation records.

steps.title: Real-time Booking Conflict Prevention
steps.instruction: Implement a strict locking strategy using database transactions to prevent concurrent booking requests from reserving the exact same venue slot.
steps.acceptance: Concurrency test suite successfully simulates parallel booking attempts for the same slot, allowing only one to succeed while rejecting subsequent attempts.

steps.title: Automated Email Confirmation Service
steps.instruction: Configure an asynchronous notification worker to dispatch email confirmations with reservation receipts once a booking transaction is completed.
steps.acceptance: The service correctly queues notification tasks to a background broker and dispatches formatted confirmation emails upon successful booking events.
